goal: One paragraph judges will read: what this is, who uses it, and what job it does. No product names.
reference: What the bar is, in a few words, or null. Its files go in reference/ next to this file.

criteria.means: A first-time user can find and finish the main tasks without guessing.
criteria.levels: 9: every task has one obvious path. 7: the main tasks work, one needs a second look. 5: at least one task needs hunting.

must: Deleting something asks first and names what will be deleted.
